data.description: Implement Narrative Evolution with Checkpoints and Evidence

data.feedback: Need a develop_plan prompt similar to explore_idea that captures feedback on generated plans. Must support both wide feedback (change all steps) and narrow feedback (specific sentences). Should store plan pre/post feedback and auto-create checkpoints for each feedback item.
explore_idea needs to capture the WHOLE conversation - not just user answers, but also the questions they were responding to. Full conversational context is critical.

data.title: Create develop_plan Prompt for Plan Refinement
data.description: Build plan refinement workflow with feedback capture as foundation for later enhancements (checkpointing, full conversation capture)

data.feedback: Evidence gathering should leverage the MODEL's capabilities, not just RiotPlan. When running in Cursor/Claude/ChatGPT, the model should use its own MCP tools and built-in capabilities (web search, file analysis, etc.) to gather evidence. RiotPlan provides the structure to capture evidence, but the model does the gathering. This is a symbiotic relationship.
Investigate MCP Sampling for evidence gathering - this might be the mechanism for models to autonomously gather evidence.
Support pasted text as evidence. Users will frequently paste long transcripts, notes, or text and say 'some of this might inform the plan.' Need to handle this gracefully and incorporate as evidence.
Support file references as evidence. Users will point to files and ask the model to analyze and incorporate as evidence. Model should read, understand, and attach with appropriate description.

Need higher-level execute_plan prompt instead of low-level execute_step. User wants to say 'execute_plan' and have it automatically look at state, determine which step to start, and guide execution. Current tools (execute_step, track_progress) are too granular.

data.title: Create execute_plan Prompt for High-Level Execution
data.description: Build intelligent execution workflow that automatically manages state, determines next step, and guides user through execution

data.feedback: Add documentation step to capture user stories showing RiotPlan works for both fast users ('just build me a plan') and thorough users ('I want to ideate'). Need stories in README.md, guide/, and docs/ to communicate that the tool supports both quick execution and deep exploration.

data.title: Document User Stories and Workflows
data.description: Create story-driven documentation with four user journeys (5 min, 15 min, 1-2 hrs, multiple days) showing flexibility from fast execution to deep ideation
